title: Bank & ATM Explorer: ATM Mission
learningGoals: Identify critical safety rules for ATM usage
Keep the PIN secret and secure

teachingScript.teacherLine: Need cash? An ATM (Automated Teller Machine) is your 24/7 bank assistant. Let's try to withdraw ₹500 safely.
Safety is #1! Always remember the Golden Rules of the ATM.

data.title: ATM Golden Rules
points: Never share your PIN with anyone.
Cover the keypad with your hand when typing.
Always take your card and receipt immediately.
remember: Don't accept help from strangers at the machine.
Check for any loose parts on the card slot.
